issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם' (whose name was changed) is not fully rendered; the Vietnamese says 'rồi đổi tên Síp-ma' (then changed the name of Sibmah), but the Hebrew indicates that Nebo and Baal-meon had their names changed, and Sibmah is listed as a third city, not the object of the renaming. The Vietnamese omits the renaming of Nebo and Baal-meon and incorrectly attaches the renaming to Sibmah.
